  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}
  function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Modal (نافذة التوضيح)
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showInfoModal(data){const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn,summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn,steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn,hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps",hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;root.appendChild(overlay);requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}}
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render Functions
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderStats(){if(!statsSection)return;statsSection.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c=>`<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}"><div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div><div class="erp-stat-info"><span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span><span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;if(window.frappe)statsCards.forEach(c=>c.fetch().then(v=>{const el=statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`);if(el)el.textContent=formatNumber(v);}));}
  function renderQuickActions(){if(!quickActions)return;quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" ${b.isReport?'data-is-report="1"':""} ${b.isTree?'data-is-tree="1"':""} style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");if(!b||!window.frappe)return;if(b.dataset.isReport==="1"){frappe.set_route("query-report",b.dataset.newDoc);return;}if(b.dataset.isTree==="1"){frappe.set_route("Tree","Account");return;}if(typeof frappe.new_doc==="function")frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc);});}
  function renderSections(){root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{const lh=c[2].map(i=>{const d=itemDescriptions[i],dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details",ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";return`<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`;}).join("");return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`;}).join("");return`<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`;}).join("");}
  function renderFooter(){if(!footerEl)return;const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;}
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Routing
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function openRoute(n){if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;if(reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;}if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}if(treeDocs.has(n)){const treeMap={"Chart of Accounts":"Account","Chart of Cost Centers":"Cost Center"};frappe.set_route("Tree",treeMap[n]||n);return;}frappe.set_route("List",n);}
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Event Delegation
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let lastToggleTime=0;
  content.addEventListener("click",event=>{const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Init
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  renderStats();renderQuickActions();renderSections();renderFooter();
})();
